items.stem: Explain why, in a model dN/dt = −kN with k > 0, the minus sign is needed for a decreasing quantity.

items.stem: Elena solves dy/dx = y² cos x and writes the answer without using the condition y = 1 when x = 0. Explain the difference between the general and particular solutions here.
items.answer: General: −1/y = sin x + c (a family of curves). Particular: the condition fixes the constant, giving y = 1/(1 − sin x).
items.markingKey: B1 general solution is a family; B1 particular solution found [2]
